# Wiktionary

> > A comprehensive multilingual dictionary providing definitions, pronunciations, etymologies, and grammatical information for words and phrases across hundreds of languages.

Wiktionary is a collaborative free dictionary project that documents words from English and other languages including Latin, Turkish, and more. Each entry includes detailed linguistic information such as International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) pronunciations, grammatical forms (verb conjugations, noun declensions), usage notes, and alternative spellings, with pronunciation guides following Received Pronunciation and General American English standards.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions
- International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)
- Verb conjugations and forms
- Past tense and past participle
- Received Pronunciation
- General American English
- Latin grammar and declensions
- Noun definitions and inflections
- Alternative forms and spellings
- Pronunciation guides
- Multilingual phrasebook entries
- English language grammar
- Etymology and word origins
- Genitive and declension patterns
- Colloquial and slang expressions

## English Language Entries

- [street credibility](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/street_credibility): Dictionary entry for 'street credibility' noun with alternative forms
- [started](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/started): Dictionary entry for 'started' verb form with IPA pronunciation guide
- [modded](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/modded): Dictionary entry for 'modded' past tense and participle verb form

## Latin Language Entries

- [debere](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/debere): Latin verb form entry showing inflection and grammar details
- [corticis](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/corticis): Latin noun form entry showing genitive singular declension

## Phrasebook and Multilingual Expressions

- [çok teşekkür ederim](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/çok_teşekkür_ederim): Turkish phrasebook entry for gratitude expression 'thank you very much'
